license.name: Unlicense build scripts; bundled GNU/GCC/MinGW-w64 component licences

notes: w64devkit fortran ZIP: portable MinGW-w64 GCC 13.1.0 with gfortran, gcc, binutils, GDB and GNU Make. Use it to compile .f/.f90 files, create native Windows executables, run Makefile builds and debug with gdb from OpenMind terminals. OpenMind Studio adds this install's bin folder to launched processes only; the system PATH is not changed.
